channel.title: Education — Awesome Bharat
channel.description: Learning, teaching, and knowledge for all.

item.title: Think School
item.description: Think School is a popular Indian YouTube channel that breaks down complex topics in business, finance, geopolitics, and economics through visually rich, data-driven storytelling — making learning accessible and entertaining.

item.title: Dhruv Rathee
item.description: Dhruv Rathee is one of India's most influential YouTube educators, known for his researched explainers on politics, climate change, history, and social issues — backed by data, citations, and a clear, rational voice.

item.title: The Ken
item.description: The Ken is a subscription-based digital publication that delivers incisive, deeply reported analysis of business, technology, and science — with a sharp focus on the startups, companies, and ideas shaping India and Southeast Asia.

item.title: YourStory
item.description: YourStory is India's premier media platform for startups, entrepreneurship, and innovation — covering the people, ideas, and trends that define the Indian startup ecosystem.

item.title: GDG India
item.description: Google Developer Groups (GDG) India is a community-driven network of 50+ city chapters across India where developers, designers, and tech enthusiasts learn Google technologies, build projects, and grow together.

item.title: The Product Folks
item.description: The Product Folks (TPF) is India's largest product management community — a thriving network of 50,000+ product managers, designers, and tech leaders who learn, share, and grow together through events, mentorship, and curated content.

item.title: The Seen and The Unseen
item.description: The Seen and The Unseen is India's sharpest longform podcast, hosted by Amit Varma — exploring Indian society, politics, economics, and culture through deep, witty, and intellectually honest conversations.

item.title: Teach For India
item.description: Teach For India is a nationwide movement that enlists India's brightest graduates and professionals to teach in under-resourced schools — working to end educational inequity, one classroom at a time.

item.title: Project Nanhi Kali
item.description: Project Nanhi Kali is India's largest girl-child education program, supporting over 200,000 underprivileged girls across 14 states with academic, material, and digital support so they can stay in school and complete their education.
